terms.gloss: no, not at all (refusing or denying)
terms.comment: The plain no of comedy to a question or a request; its pair is Maximē!, yes, certainly (see yes).

terms.gloss: absolutely not! not in the world
by no means, not at all
evidence: Cic. de Or. 2.143: haudquāquam id est difficile Crassō (Lewis & Short s.v. haud)
terms.comment: An adverb within a sentence (haud quāquam, by no way whatever), not a one-word answer: for that, minimē.

phrases.english: Ah, absolutely not; I won’t do it.

phrases.latin: At istōs rāstrōs intereā tamen appōne: nē labōrā. — Minimē.
phrases.english: “But put those hoes down for now; don’t work.” “No.”
